figurative_meaning_bn: সংখ্যা ও পরিমাণ (অগণিত বা অসীমিত পরিমাণ)
figurative_meaning_en: count or measure (innumerable or boundless quantity)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আকাশের তারার লেখাজোখা করা যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no count of his wealth.
The stars in the sky cannot be counted.
note: The idiom often implies an unmanageable or vast amount, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to express excess.
